# CA.gov
> Official portal for California state government services, information, departments, and public assistance.

CA.gov helps residents, businesses, workers, and visitors find California government services, agency directories, public programs, legal information, and support resources. It serves as the statewide entry point to online services and topic-based guidance.

## Main Portal
- [Home](https://www.ca.gov/): California state portal homepage with service search, popular services, and topic navigation.
- [Services](https://www.ca.gov/services/): Browse California government services by category and common public needs.
- [Departments](https://www.ca.gov/departments/): Directory of California state departments, agencies, boards, and commissions.
- [About California](https://www.ca.gov/about-california/): Overview information about the state of California and government context.
- [Get help](https://www.ca.gov/support/): Support resources for using CA.gov and finding government assistance.
- [Sitemap](https://www.ca.gov/about/sitemap/): Structured index of pages and sections available on CA.gov.

## Popular Services
- [Real ID/license](https://www.ca.gov/services/?q=real%20id): Entry point for Real ID and driver license-related state services.
- [Birth certificates](https://www.ca.gov/services/?q=birth%20certificates): Find information and services related to obtaining birth certificates.
- [Check your refund](https://www.ca.gov/services/?q=check%20your%20refund): Access tax refund lookup and related California refund resources.
- [Traffic tickets](https://www.ca.gov/services/?q=traffic%20tickets): Find court and payment resources for California traffic tickets.
- [Business license](https://www.ca.gov/services/?q=business%20license): Locate business licensing information and related state requirements.
- [Seller’s permit](https://www.ca.gov/services/?q=seller%E2%80%99s%20permit): Find seller’s permit information and tax registration resources.

## Service Topics
- [DMV/Auto](https://www.ca.gov/services/?q=dmv): Vehicle registration, licensing, and driver-related California services.
- [Personal records](https://www.ca.gov/services/?q=personal%20records): Services for vital records, identification, and personal documentation.
- [Businesses](https://www.ca.gov/services/?q=businesses): California services for starting, operating, and managing a business.
- [Jobs and unemployment](https://www.ca.gov/services/?q=jobs%20and%20unemployment): Employment, unemployment, and workforce-related state resources.
- [Social services](https://www.ca.gov/services/?q=social%20services): Public assistance, benefits, and family support program resources.
- [Popular topics](https://www.ca.gov/services/): Browse commonly requested California service categories and topics.

## Government Directory
- [Departments directory](https://www.ca.gov/departments/): Browse California state departments and agencies from the central directory.
- [Services directory](https://www.ca.gov/services/): Explore service listings across agencies and public programs.
- [Support](https://www.ca.gov/support/): Get help navigating the portal or locating the right government resource.

## Disaster and Help Resources
- [Get disaster help](https://www.ca.gov/): Homepage access to disaster assistance and emergency-related resources.
- [Get help](https://www.ca.gov/support/): General support for finding services, information, and state contacts.
- [Services](https://www.ca.gov/services/): Search for emergency, recovery, and assistance-related government services.

## Legal and Accessibility
- [Conditions of use](https://www.ca.gov/legal/conditions-of-use/): Terms governing use of the CA.gov website and services.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.ca.gov/legal/privacy-policy/): Privacy practices for CA.gov and handling of user information.
- [Accessibility](https://www.ca.gov/legal/accessibility/): Accessibility statement and support for accessible use of CA.gov.

## About the State
- [About California](https://www.ca.gov/about-california/): General information about California and the state government portal.
- [Home](https://www.ca.gov/): Portal overview with featured services, topics, and statewide information.
- [Sitemap](https://www.ca.gov/about/sitemap/): Navigate the site structure for California government portal content.
